name: arxiv_rlad_math_reasoning_benchmark_hints_iter1_prompt
description: A collection of prompts/hints designed for iterative math reasoning evaluation and RL-assisted alignment experiments. It measures models' ability to solve math problems when provided with hint-oriented prompts and iterative guidance strategies. The dataset is intended for research on prompting, hint generation, and improving stepwise math reasoning.
reputation: A research-oriented prompt set used in studies on math reasoning and RL/AL alignment; limited but relevant adoption in specialized research.
